cause: The transaction was initially modeled as authorization of paths, then as an immutable tree plus branch CAS, without enumerating every state transition through the API return boundary; independent and self-adversarial review exposed each omitted consumer of that authorization.
prevention: For every privileged SCM action, enumerate the complete publication timeline and bind exact content, real worktree identity, ref target, compare-and-swap value, owned locks, configured hooks, cleanup, and return-state verification; require deterministic adjacent-state attacks before consumer adoption.
summary: Three successive claim-SCM defects passed narrower checks while leaving the committed tree, symbolic-HEAD target, or Runtime-invoked post-hook outside the protected authorization boundary.
title: Claim authorization must cover the final publication boundary
